contexts.text: The first-fruits of the earth which they brought into the house of Jehovah () = the states of innocence which exist in infancy.
The first-fruits of the fruit of the earth () = the goods thence derived.

The first-fruits of thy corn, and the firstfruits of thy wine, thou shalt not delay () = that as all goods and truths are from the Lord, they ought to be ascribed to Him, and not to self. (For) first-fruits = those things which must be in the first place, thus which must be the primary of all...

The first-fruits which were to be offered to the Lord were the first-fruits of harvest and the firstfruits of the vintage, also the first-fruits of shearing, and the first-fruits of the fruit. The first-fruits of harvest were ears of corn parched and green, also the sheaf which was to be waved, and afterwards what was from the corn-floor, which was cakes. The first-fruits of the vintage were the first-fruits of the wine, of the must, and of the oil... The first-fruits and the firstborn things were offered to Jehovah, and by Jehovah were given to Aaron and his seed, because (they) represented the Lord.
What the first-fruits specifically represented... appears from the signification of the various things from which the first-fruits were given.

That the first-fruits were given to Jehovah, signified that it was the first of the Church to ascribe all goods and truths of faith to the Lord, and not to self... The reason the first-fruits had this signification, is that the first-fruits were offerings and gifts, which were thanksgivings for the produce of the earth, and an acknowledgement of blessings from Jehovah, consequently an acknowledgement that all things are from Him... Illustrated.

The feast of the harvest of the first-fruits of the works which thou hast sown in the field () = the worship of the Lord and thanksgiving on account of the implantation of truth in good... The first-fruits or the beginnings of works = the things which are the last of instruction and the first of life.

The introduction of the sons of Israel into Canaan had a like representation to that of this second feast, which was called the feast of the first-fruits of works, and also the feast of weeks, namely, the implantation of truth in good. Explained.

The first of the first-fruits of thy ground thou shalt bring into the house of thy God ()-that all the truths of good and goods of truth are holy, because from the Lord alone. (For) the first-fruits of the ground = that the goods and truths of the Church are to be ascribed to the Lord alone... It is said the first of the first-fruits, because this must be the primary thing...
The sheaf of the first-fruits () = the state thereof collectively.
As these laws (of the Decalogue) were the first-fruits of the Word, and consequently the firstfruits of the Church... TCR 283. TCR 776:2. AE 1073:2.
The first-fruits unto God and the Lamb () = the initiament of the Christian Heaven... By the first-fruits is meant that which is born first, also what is first gathered, thus an initiament.

It was commanded... that the first-fruits of the produce of the fields, of all the corn, oil, and must, of the fruits of trees, and also of the fleece, should be given to Jehovah as holy; and by Jehovah they were given to Aaron, and after him to the high priest (; ; , etc.). Also, that they should celebrate the feast of first-fruits of the harvest and of bread (; ; ). The reason was, that the firstfruits = that which is born first, and which afterwards grows up... and thus they = everything which follows until it is complete; for all that follows is in the first, as the man is in the infant... and as this first exists before the successions... the first-fruits were holy to the Lord, and the feast of first-fruits was celebrated. Like things are signified by first-fruits in ; ; ; .
Impart to their wives the first-fruits of their vigour.
The first-fruits of oils with which they anoint themselves () = the external things of good from which, also, there is worship.
First-fruits = genuine things.
The first-fruits of the mountains of the east () = the genuine goods of love to the Lord, and thence of charity towards the neighbour.
That it is from primary things, is signified by he saw the first-fruits for himself ().

The first-fruits to God and the Lamb = those who have given themselves to the Lord and been adopted by Him. That they are those of the New Church, is evident from their being called the first-fruits unto God and the Lamb...

What is signified by first-fruits. Firstfruits have a like signification to first-born, but first-born is predicated of animals, and first-fruits of plants, thus first-horn things are those which are horn first, and first-fruits are from the first things which are produced, and both = the spiritual good which is first formed, which, in itself, is truth from the good which is from the Lord; (for) as soon as the spiritual mind is opened, good is produced and the derivative truth, and this which is first produced is meant by the first-born and the first-fruits. And as all things produced from the spiritual mind are... from the Lord alone, these things were sanctified to Jehovah... because they were His, and consequently were holy. And as that which is first born or produced = all things which follow in the series... the first-born things and the first-fruits being given to the Lord = that all the rest were also His. Further explained.
